name: Daunting X
description: The attack or hazard cuts into a target's Willpower in addition to their HP. Add +X Willpower damage for each [!] rolled.

name: Destructive
description: The attack or hazard can quickly overcome physical obstacles, and deals double damage when targeting objects. When targeting an enemy unit benefiting from Half-Cover, if you roll 3 or more [!], you may reduce your damage by 2 to destroy that instance of Half-Cover.

name: Draining
description: If a number of [!] are rolled that equals or exceeds the target's Faith Effect Save, the target gains the Weakened condition until the end of their next turn.

name: Knockdown
description: The attack or hazard causes the target to stumble or fall. If a number of [!] are rolled that equals or exceeds the target's Brawn Effect Save, the target is knocked prone.

name: Persistent X
description: The attack or hazard has a lingering effect. The target must succeed on a Difficulty 2 Brawn + Medicine Task at the end of their turn or suffer X [CD] damage (of the same type as the initial attack), continuing each round until they succeed or benefit from a First Aid action. Multiple instances stack. Persistent damage ignores Resistance.

name: Pinning
description: If a number of [!] are rolled that equals or exceeds the target's Coordination Effect Save, they become Immobilized and must spend a Minor Action to break free.

name: Provoking
description: If a number of [!] are rolled that equals or exceeds the target's current Willpower, the target becomes Enraged until the end of their next turn, with the attacker as their source of rage.

name: Startling
description: If a number of [!] are rolled that equals or exceeds the target's Awareness Effect Save, the target is Off-Guard until the end of their next turn.

name: Stunning
description: The attack or hazard leaves the target momentarily unable to act. If a number of [!] are rolled that equals or exceeds the target's Awareness Effect Save, the target is Dazed until the end of their next turn.

name: Terrifying
description: If a number of [!] are rolled that equals or exceeds the target's Willpower, the target is Frightened of you until they are consoled by an ally.
